questions.question: Does the published @excalidraw/excalidraw@0.18.1 npm package persist scenes to localStorage automatically, or is persistence delegated to the host shell?
questions.resolution: Resolved by REA audit and runtime execution: dist/prod/index.js does NOT auto-persist to localStorage. Persistence keys ('excalidraw' and 'excalidraw-state') are owned by excalidraw-app/app_constants.ts and excalidraw-app/data/localStorage.ts via the component's onChange callback and initialData prop.

questions.question: How does Excalidraw v0.18.1 render elements in dark theme without mutating stored hex colors in .excalidraw JSON?
questions.resolution: Resolved by CSS inspection (packages/excalidraw/css/theme.scss:172-185) and live runtime observation (EV-008): .excalidraw.theme--dark sets --default-bg-color: #121212 and applies CSS filter invert(93%) hue-rotate(180deg) (THEME_FILTER) to the canvas layer while preserving original element strokeColor/backgroundColor values in scene JSON.

questions.question: Does programmatic or pointer arrow creation populate startBinding/endBinding when endpoints land on shape boundaries?
questions.resolution: Verified via live canvas drag from rectangle right edge to ellipse left edge in Chromium (EV-004); binding fields (elementId, focus, gap) and reciprocal boundElements references on target shapes are captured directly from live scene state.

questions.question: Does the official npm tarball excalidraw-0.18.1.tgz match the registry SHA-512 integrity digest and correspond to git tag v0.18.1?
questions.resolution: Verified cryptographically (EV-012): computed SHA-512 matches npm dist.integrity exactly, computed SHA-1 matches dist.shasum, and package.json version 0.18.1 matches git tag v0.18.1 (a2ec2889babf7d2295469c6d90ebe77fae57df84).
